Resource.Desc: Books: search, read with author and reviews, create with validation, update, delete.

Request.Sql: SELECT b.id, b.title, b.price, a.name AS author FROM book b JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE b.author_id = $author_id ORDER BY b.title
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.price, a.name AS author FROM book b JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE LOWER(b.title) LIKE LOWER('%$q%') ORDER BY b.title
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.price, a.name AS author FROM book b JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id ORDER BY b.title
SELECT b.id, b.title, b.isbn, b.price, b.stock, a.name AS author FROM book b JOIN author a ON a.id = b.author_id WHERE b.id = $id
SELECT rating, comment FROM review WHERE book_id = $id ORDER BY id
INSERT INTO book (author_id, title, isbn, price, stock) VALUES ($author_id, $title, $isbn, $price, $stock)
SELECT id, title, isbn, price, stock FROM book WHERE isbn = $isbn
UPDATE book SET price = $price WHERE id = $id
UPDATE book SET stock = $stock WHERE id = $id
